comeragh_farmwife.text: Come in out of the wind. Waterford folk call themselves the Déise, and our county in Irish is Port Láirge.
Waterford city is said to be the oldest in Ireland. The Vikings founded it in 914, and it has been arguing about it since.
Mind the Pooka on the heather roads. Folk say it spoils the blackberries after Samhain, so we pick them early.
